ios.desc:
Pack tomorrow tonight—and make school mornings feel lighter.

ParentPackIt is a family packing checklist for school, daycare, sports, trips, and everyday routines. Create a checklist for each child, choose which days items are needed, and check everything off before you leave home.

PLAN UP TO A WEEK AHEAD
Switch from Today to any of the next six days. See what each child needs, prepare tomorrow’s bag in the evening, and keep future checkmarks separate from today’s progress.

BUILD ROUTINES THAT FIT YOUR FAMILY
• Create individual profiles for each child
• Add items, notes, photos, recurring days, and reminders
• View Scheduled items or All Items
• Check off one item, a whole section, or an entire saved list
• Skip an item for one day without deleting its recurring schedule

KEEP LONG LISTS CLEAR
Start quickly with the free Daycare sample. Organize standalone items into collapsible sections such as Sports Kit, Swimming, or Daycare. Pro and Lifetime add reusable saved lists for school, sports, travel, and weekends.

FREE FEATURES
• Seven-day planning
• Daily packing checklists
• Up to two children
• Daycare sample list
• Daily reminders
• Blue theme
• Optional personal iCloud backup (off by default)

PRO AND LIFETIME
Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription, with a one-week free trial on Monthly. It unlocks unlimited children, sections, saved lists, item photos, Today and Lock Screen widgets, smart notifications, all color themes, dark mode, Apple Family Sharing, and sharing a child’s list with a co-parent.

Lifetime is a one-time purchase with the same features as Pro. Apple Family Sharing shares the purchase with up to six people in your Apple Family; it does not share packing lists. Invite another parent from a child’s profile when you need the lists themselves to stay in sync. In-app purchases are optional.

BUILT FOR REAL FAMILY ROUTINES
ParentPackIt is designed for parents and caregivers, with clear progress, friendly controls, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver support, dark mode, and Reduce Motion support.

UPGRADING FROM VERSION 1.0?
Your existing children, checklist items, saved lists, reminders, completion history, and purchases remain in place. Version 2.0 adds planning, photos, widgets, and optional sharing without asking you to rebuild your routines.

Whether you’re packing a school bag, daycare supplies, a sports kit, or a suitcase, ParentPackIt helps your family leave with what they need.

Privacy Policy: https://parent-pack-it-web.vercel.app/privacy-po
